s1.syndrome_frame: Multiple skin-colored papules on the face and vulva with a gradual increase in number over time
salient_findings: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules on the face and vulva
Family history of similar facial papules
Histopathology showing buds and cords of basaloid cells with small cystic spaces
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 60s
Lesions first appeared around 50 years of age
Approximately 60 lesions are present
Lesions are asymptomatic
Medical history includes a meningioma
Family history of similar facial papules in a daughter
No palmar or plantar pits observed
Histopathology of lesions shows basaloid cells with small cystic spaces
Clefting between tumor aggregates and surrounding stroma is evident
Genetic testing revealed a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene

raw.syndrome_frame: Multiple skin-colored papules on the face and vulva with a gradual increase in number over time
salient_findings: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules on the face and vulva
Family history of similar facial papules
Histopathology showing buds and cords of basaloid cells with small cystic spaces
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 60s
Lesions first appeared around 50 years of age
Approximately 60 lesions are present
Lesions are asymptomatic
Medical history includes a meningioma
Family history of similar facial papules in a daughter
No palmar or plantar pits observed
Histopathology of lesions shows basaloid cells with small cystic spaces
Clefting between tumor aggregates and surrounding stroma is evident
Genetic testing revealed a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene

raw.rationale: The histopathology showing buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces and the clinical presentation of multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules are consistent with trichofolliculomas. The genetic testing revealing a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene also supports this diagnosis, as SUFU mutations are associated with trichofolliculomas.

rejected.label: trichodiscoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific histopathological features characteristic of trichodiscoma

rejected.label: syringoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with smaller, more translucent papules and lacks the basaloid cell morphology seen in this case

rejected.label: asymptomatic
rejected.why: Not a specific diagnosis, but rather a characteristic of the lesions

rejected.label: lipoid proteinosis
rejected.why: Typically presents with a broader range of symptoms including hoarseness, skin lesions, and other systemic findings, which are not seen in this case
